identificationModule.briefTitle: Prostate Cancer Prevention Study for Men With High Grade PIN (Prostatic Intraepithelial Neoplasia)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Efficacy and Safety Study of Toremifene Citrate for the Prevention of Prostate Cancer in Men With High Grade Prostatic Intraepithelial Neoplasia (PIN)

armGroups.label: 20 mg Toremifene Citrate
armGroups.description: The subject takes one dose by mouth of the 20mg Toremifine Citrate tablet once a day for the length of the trial (360 days).

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: The subject takes a placebo tablet identical in appearance to the toremifene 20mg tablet, administered by mouth daily for 360 days
